title: Country Code
summary: A telephone field with a country picker: a button opens a searchable listbox of countries, and the chosen country sets the dial code, flag and, optionally, the input mask of the native tel input.

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

root-class.description: Classes added to the root element the component draws.

root-style.description: Inline style declarations set on the root element the component draws, custom properties included.

required.description: Native required phone input; the country prefix alone does not satisfy the requirement.

name.description: Native input name used by FormData and form submission.

locale.description: Language of the country names and the field's own words: ru or en. When not set it follows the page: Russian on a Russian page, English otherwise.

use-country-masks.description: Deprecated until 2027-01-01 (change journal attribute-input-country-presence-booleans): on by default, so it was switched off by the string "false", which is not an HTML boolean. Write fixed-mask instead; use-country-masks="false" keeps working until the date.

fixed-mask.description: With use-mask, one mask for every country -- mask-pattern -- instead of each country's own. The presence form of use-country-masks="false".

show-code.description: Deprecated until 2027-01-01 (change journal attribute-input-country-presence-booleans): on by default, so it was switched off by the string "false", which is not an HTML boolean. Write hide-code instead; show-code="false" keeps working until the date.

hide-code.description: The dial code is not written before the number. The presence form of show-code="false".

multi-country.description: Deprecated until 2027-01-01 (change journal attribute-input-country-presence-booleans): on by default, so it was switched off by the string "false", which is not an HTML boolean. Write fixed-country instead; multi-country="false" keeps working until the date.

fixed-country.description: Only the country iso2 or dial-code names: the flag and the code are a picture, not a list. The presence form of multi-country="false".

lazy-flags.description: Deprecated until 2027-01-01 (change journal attribute-input-country-presence-booleans): on by default, so it was switched off by the string "false", which is not an HTML boolean. Write eager-flags instead; lazy-flags="false" keeps working until the date.

eager-flags.description: Every flag of the list is fetched when the list is built, not as its row comes into view. The presence form of lazy-flags="false".

aria-label.description: Accessible name for a telephone field rendered without a visible label.

setState.summary: Applies disabled, open (or active), value, iso2 and dialCode to the rendered field; setting value dispatches native input and change from the inner input. Returns true when applied, false before render.

change.summary: The phone value or country was committed; the native event bubbles from the inner input, which is its target. It carries no detail. The name to bind.

payload.description: A native Event: there is no detail.
A native Event: there is no detail.

accessibility.focus: Country-code button opens a single-select listbox. Arrows, Home, End and typeahead move focus without changing the phone; Enter/Space commit and Escape cancels. Closing by confirmation or Escape returns focus to the button; Tab leaves without trapping focus. Disabled fields do not open.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-input-country when the interface needs the country code behavior.
do_not: Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not move host data or access decisions into the component
